name: The Key
intro: You will fill in a few made-up lines about where things are kept, watch the ✓ marks and the progress bar change, check that it all stays after a reload and with no internet, and look at the print preview. Please use only the example words — never real passwords or account numbers.

steps.do: Look at the welcome card at the bottom (“Welcome to The Key”). Tap the small words “skip the tour” at its bottom right.
steps.see: A new card asks how you want to start, with two big choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may also show at the top (for example “Good morning.”). Tap its ✕ if it is in the way.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.see: A small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” with OK and Cancel.
The card goes away. Near the top it says “Nothing filled in yet — start anywhere.” and the first section, “📷 My pictures live here”, is open.

steps.do: Scroll down past the five sections and tap the big “🖨 Print my Key” button, before you have written anything.
steps.see: Nothing prints. A box says “Fill in at least one section first — even one line helps them someday.” Tap OK.

steps.do: Scroll back up. In “📷 My pictures live here”, tap “＋ Add a place your pictures live”.
steps.see: A panel slides up titled “Add a place your pictures live”, with choices like Phone, iCloud Photos, Google Photos, Computer and Photo albums.
steps.tip: In this test copy the purple bar covers the panel’s Save button. That is a known problem, already reported — just close the panel in the next step.

steps.do: Tap the dim strip at the very top of the screen, above the panel.
steps.see: The panel closes and you are back on the page. Nothing new was added.

steps.do: Still in “📷 My pictures live here”, tap the box under “Other notes (optional)” and type this example.
steps.type: Old photo albums are in the hall closet, top shelf (example)
steps.see: Your words are in the box, and “✓ started” appears on the right of the “📷 My pictures live here” heading.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap the heading “💌 Anything else they should know” to open it.
steps.see: It opens. It says “A wish, an instruction, a kindness. In your own words.” and has a box with grey example words about the dog’s vet.

steps.do: Tap that box and type this example (with the apostrophe).
steps.type: Margaret O'Brien has the spare house key. (example)
steps.see: The apostrophe in O'Brien looks right, “✓ started” appears next to “💌 Anything else they should know”, and the bar at the top now says “Your Key: 1 of 5 sections started · 20% of the boxes filled in”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Both of your lines are still there — the hall closet note and the Margaret O'Brien note — each with “✓ started” next to its heading. No welcome card comes back.

steps.do: Tap the heading “💻 My accounts that matter” to open it.
steps.see: It opens and says “The accounts your family would need to find or close. Never the password itself.” with a “＋ Add an account” button.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap the “Other notes (optional)” box in “💻 My accounts that matter” and type this example.
steps.type: Bank statements are in the blue folder in the desk (example)
steps.see: It still works with no internet: your words stay in the box and “✓ started” appears next to “💻 My accounts that matter”.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Then pull the page down to reload it.
steps.see: The blue folder note is still there, so it was saved even with no internet.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “🖨 Print my Key”.
steps.see: A print preview opens: a clean page headed “🔑 The Key” with “Updated” and today’s date, then each section in capitals (“📷 MY PICTURES LIVE HERE”, “💻 MY ACCOUNTS THAT MATTER” …) with your lines under them and a “—” under the empty ones. The buttons are not on it (in the test copy a plain purple strip may print at the bottom). Tap Cancel.

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom and tap “Start over”.
steps.see: A box asks “Clear everything and start over?”. Tap Cancel — nothing is erased.

steps.do: Scroll back to the top of the page.
steps.see: Your three example lines are still there, with “✓ started” next to 📷 My pictures live here, 💻 My accounts that matter and 💌 Anything else they should know.
